items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Ham Davis, Leonard Davis. He's dead, they called him Ham. Oh, we had so many musicians.

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean, Shorty, he was a fine trumpet.
Yeah. And Irving Randolph. Now he's out of the business. Ham Davis, Leonard Davis. He's dead, they called him Ham. Oh, we had so many musicians.
Yeah, it was like a real school.
